findings.governingReading: The reputed technique removes a tumor without putting a scalpel into the patient.
findings.explanation: Infected part replaces a tumor with infection, changing the medical condition used in Shirou’s analogy.

findings.highlight: there are only a few in the church that can handle spirits as well as you do
findings.evidenceJa: 教会の秘蹟使いだって、貴方ほど霊体を繕える人はごく一部
findings.governingReading: Even among the Church’s sacrament practitioners, very few can mend spiritual bodies as well as Kirei.
findings.explanation: The English removes the specialist role and weakens mending spirits into generic handling.

findings.highlight: break the contract with Saber by choice
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の判断だけで白紙に戻す
findings.governingReading: Shirou would erase the contract by his judgment alone.
findings.explanation: By choice omits the unilateral exclusion of Saber that makes the act feel like betrayal.

findings.highlight: My legs hurt like they’re about to tear off
findings.governingReading: The sweep has cracked the bones in both legs, which now hurt as though they might tear off.
findings.explanation: The English preserves extreme pain but deletes the confirmed structural injury.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=そのからだ char=4]魔力回路を貰い受ける
findings.governingReading: Saber says she will take Shirou’s Magic Circuits, displayed with “that body” as the ruby reading.
findings.explanation: The English retains only body and deletes the system term that explains what she needs from killing him.

findings.highlight: It would be bad for both you and me
findings.evidenceJa: 俺だけでなくセイバーさえ、取り返しのつかない事になるだろう
findings.governingReading: Both Shirou and even Saber would face consequences that could never be undone.
findings.explanation: Would be bad removes irreversibility and the emphatic extension from himself to Saber.

findings.highlight: I didn’t even have a chance to see it, scream, nor turn and run.
findings.governingReading: There is no interval even to exchange words before the attack lands.
findings.explanation: Scream replaces reciprocal speech with a unilateral panic reaction absent from the fragmented source.
